data_provenance: Stage 09 aligned diagnostic arrays carried through Stage 10. B is Reader v1.2 diagnostic output, not independently re-exported from browser UI; conclusions apply to this diagnostic pair.

method.floor: median power over time for each frequency bin, median-smoothed across 9 frequency bins
method.typing: S0 <6 dB; S1 6 to <12 dB; S2 12 to <24 dB; S3 >=24 dB above local frequency floor
method.regions: 2-D 3x3 binary closing on S2/S3; 8-neighbour components; retain area >=4 cells and duration >=2 frames
method.caution: S0 means below the detector's activity threshold, not mathematically zero or proven inaudible. S1 is intentionally ambiguous/low activity.
